label: prop:em-coupling-fixed-point
title: $\alpha_{EM}$ as the root of the self-consistent fixed-point cubic $-h^2H\alpha^3 + H\alpha^2 + T\alpha - 1 = 0$ (conditional on the $B_3(\mathbb{C})$ $\mathcal{O}(\alpha^2)$ normalization)
html:
Theorem (conditional on the B_3(\mathbb{C}) \mathcal{O}(\alpha^2) normalization class). Let q be the substrate parameter and write

  T \;=\; q\cdot[9]_q\cdot[10]_q + \frac{2}{3\pi},
  \qquad
  H \;=\; \frac{[2]_q}{8\pi},
  \qquad
  h \;=\; \frac{q-1}{q}.

Assume the typeclass QOU.ArchimedeanUniverse.AlphaEmFixedPointNormalization is inhabited at (q,\alpha). The exact \mathcal{O}(\alpha^2) self-energy normalization of the coupling equation is H\cdot(1-h^2\alpha). This is the archimedean image of a class in the Bloch group B_3(\mathbb{C}). Consequently, \alpha solves the self-consistent fixed point:

  \frac{1}{\alpha}
  \;=\;
  T + \alpha\,H\,\bigl(1 - h^2\alpha\bigr).

Then \alpha is a root of the characteristic cubic:

  P(\alpha)
  \;=\;
  -h^2 H\,\alpha^3 + H\,\alpha^2 + T\,\alpha - 1
  \;=\; 0,

and its inverse yields CODATA-consistency: \lvert \alpha^{-1} - 137.035999177\rvert < 10^{-3}.
